mapper.sql: role_id as "roleId",tenant_id as "tenantId",role_code as "roleCode",role_name as "roleName", description,role_type as "roleType",status,system_managed as "systemManaged",created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt",created_by as "createdBy",updated_by as "updatedBy",version

select from rbac_roles where role_id in #{id} and (tenant_id=#{tenantId} or tenant_id is null) order by role_code

select grant_id as "grantId",tenant_id as "tenantId",role_id as "roleId",permission_point as "permissionCode", created_at as "createdAt",created_by as "createdBy",version from rbac_role_permissions where role_id in #{id} and (tenant_id=#{tenantId} or tenant_id is null) order by role_id,permission_point
mapper.delete: delete from rbac_role_permissions where tenant_id is not distinct from #{tenantId} and role_id=#{roleId}
mapper.sql: binding_id as "bindingId",tenant_id as "tenantId",principal_type as "principalType",principal_id as "principalId", role_id as "roleId",scope_type as "scopeType",scope_id as "scopeId",effective_at as "effectiveAt", expires_at as "expiresAt",status,created_at as "createdAt",created_by as "createdBy",revoked_at as "revokedAt", revoked_by as "revokedBy",revoke_reason as "revokeReason",version
mapper.select: select from rbac_principal_role_bindings where binding_id=#{bindingId} and (tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (#{tenantId} is null and tenant_id is null))

select from rbac_principal_role_bindings where (tenant_id=#{tenantId} or (#{tenantId} is null and tenant_id is null)) and concat(principal_type,E'\x1f',principal_id) in #{key} and status='ACTIVE' and effective_at<=#{at} and (expires_at is null or expires_at>#{at}) order by binding_id

select policy_version from rbac_policy_versions where (#{tenantId} is null and scope_type='INSTANCE' and scope_id='INSTANCE') or (#{tenantId} is not null and scope_type='TENANT' and scope_id=#{tenantId} and tenant_id=#{tenantId})

with recursive effective_groups(group_id) as ( select membership.group_id from org_group_memberships membership join organization_groups direct_group on direct_group.tenant_id=membership.tenant_id and direct_group.group_id=membership.group_id and direct_group.status='ACTIVE' where membership.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and membership.user_id=#{userId} and membership.status='ACTIVE' and membership.effective_at<=#{at} and (membership.expires_at is null or membership.expires_at>#{at}) union select parent_group.group_id from effective_groups child join organization_groups child_group on child_group.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and child_group.group_id=child.group_id and child_group.status='ACTIVE' join organization_groups parent_group on parent_group.tenant_id=child_group.tenant_id and parent_group.group_id=child_group.parent_group_id and parent_group.status='ACTIVE' ) select distinct group_id from effective_groups order by group_id

select distinct closure.ancestor_department_id from org_department_memberships membership join departments direct_department on direct_department.tenant_id=membership.tenant_id and direct_department.department_id=membership.department_id and direct_department.status='ACTIVE' join org_department_closure closure on closure.tenant_id=membership.tenant_id and closure.descendant_department_id=membership.department_id join departments effective_department on effective_department.tenant_id=closure.tenant_id and effective_department.department_id=closure.ancestor_department_id and effective_department.status='ACTIVE' where membership.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and membership.user_id=#{userId} and membership.status='ACTIVE' and membership.effective_at<=#{at} and (membership.expires_at is null or membership.expires_at>#{at}) order by closure.ancestor_department_id
mapper.insert: insert into rbac_shadow_aggregates(tenant_id,route,permission_point,legacy_decision,new_decision,reason_code,time_bucket,decision_count) values(#{row.tenantId},#{row.route},#{row.permissionCode},#{row.legacyDecision},#{row.newDecision},#{row.reasonCode},#{row.timeBucket},1) on conflict(tenant_id,route,permission_point,legacy_decision,new_decision,reason_code,time_bucket) do update set decision_count=rbac_shadow_aggregates.decision_count+1
mapper.select: with recursive group_subtree(group_id) as ( select root_group.group_id from organization_groups root_group where root_group.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and root_group.group_id=#{groupId} and root_group.status='ACTIVE' union select child.group_id from organization_groups child join group_subtree parent on child.parent_group_id=parent.group_id where child.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and child.status='ACTIVE' ) select distinct membership.user_id from org_group_memberships membership join group_subtree scope on scope.group_id=membership.group_id where membership.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and membership.status='ACTIVE' and membership.effective_at<=#{at} and (membership.expires_at is null or membership.expires_at>#{at}) order by membership.user_id

select distinct membership.user_id from org_department_memberships membership join departments root_department on root_department.tenant_id=membership.tenant_id and root_department.department_id=#{departmentId} and root_department.status='ACTIVE' join departments member_department on member_department.tenant_id=membership.tenant_id and member_department.department_id=membership.department_id and member_department.status='ACTIVE' join org_department_closure closure on closure.tenant_id=membership.tenant_id and closure.descendant_department_id=membership.department_id where membership.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and closure.ancestor_department_id=#{departmentId} and membership.status='ACTIVE' and membership.effective_at<=#{at} and (membership.expires_at is null or membership.expires_at>#{at}) order by membership.user_id

select r7_rbac_scopes_overlap(#{tenantId},#{leftType},#{leftId},#{rightType},#{rightId})
